conditionsBeforeActivation: The exact short gate must reach terminal success with all 126 tests passed and skipped=0.

Independent terminal review must confirm the actual Mac timeout/recovery and persistent-unknown cleanup paths, existing real process/generation gates and durable diagnostic privacy checks with no new meaningful finding.
Recovery must preserve partial inventory-timeout diagnostics and use only fresh complete counters; persistent timeout must retain monitor-unavailable and null resource totals with safe owned cleanup.
Actual clang before/after-cleanup diagnostics must remain bounded and normalized; the nonpublic sentinel must be absent from the entire diagnostic job log.
Recheck that no other owned native run is active before full activation. Activate this full branch once and do not rerun a prior attempt.
Existing fetch-time official metadata, unexpired status, HTTP failure handling, 600-second acquisition bound and ZIP/TAR/tree/version validations must all pass before use.
fullRun.delta: Exact reconstruction from the reviewed parent workflow using only two branch substitutions and one fixture substitution.

limits: GO is an execution-route review, not evidence that the diagnostic job, full build or native authentication has succeeded.
The historical inventory timeout root cause and original compiler cause remain unknown.
The short gate and full caller are separate push routes. The full dependency is an activation condition; the full workflow itself does not fetch or enforce the diagnostic run result.
The SDK is checked as currently unexpired metadata only; normal acquisition must independently pass its existing guards and fixed-content checks.
No new large artifact storage, privilege change, protection relaxation, product signature, publication or merge is included.

prelaunchSnapshot.scope: Read-only API snapshot before candidate branch activation; mutable state must be refreshed at dependent activation.

reviewType: independent read-only immutable caller prelaunch review
reviewerActions: Read provider commit/tree/parent metadata and regular commit file lists for both immutable caller candidates.
Read provider workflow bytes, compare exact local bytes and compare each reviewed parent diff.
Read and parse all YAML workflow files in both candidate snapshots to check push, create and workflow_run trigger overlap.
Read candidate branch refs, branch run histories, active and queued Runtime runs and current official fixed-SDK artifact metadata.
No CI, SDK payload download, source mutation, branch activation or other external write was performed.

shortGate.delta: Workflow and step display names, two exact branch substitutions, one fixture substitution and addition of test_inventory_timeout to the existing unittest command. No other file changed.
